Transaction context setup, account lookup, writability checks, and precondition filters.

# Purpose
This file implements the transaction execution context for the executor layer. It provides lifecycle functions for `fd_exec_txn_ctx_t`, including [`fd_exec_txn_ctx_new`](<#fd_exec_txn_ctx_new>), [`fd_exec_txn_ctx_join`](<#fd_exec_txn_ctx_join>), [`fd_exec_txn_ctx_leave`](<#fd_exec_txn_ctx_leave>), and [`fd_exec_txn_ctx_delete`](<#fd_exec_txn_ctx_delete>). These functions validate memory alignment, check the `magic` field, clear or set the context state, and attach the context to a scratchpad workspace. The file also sets up and resets key execution state in [`fd_exec_txn_ctx_setup_basic`](<#fd_exec_txn_ctx_setup_basic>), [`fd_exec_txn_ctx_teardown`](<#fd_exec_txn_ctx_teardown>), and [`fd_exec_txn_ctx_reset_return_data`](<#fd_exec_txn_ctx_reset_return_data>), such as account counts, compute budget data, return data, error state, and instruction tracking fields.

The file also contains helper functions for account lookup and access checks during transaction execution. Functions such as [`fd_exec_txn_ctx_get_account_at_index`](<#fd_exec_txn_ctx_get_account_at_index>), [`fd_exec_txn_ctx_get_account_with_key`](<#fd_exec_txn_ctx_get_account_with_key>), and [`fd_exec_txn_ctx_get_executable_account`](<#fd_exec_txn_ctx_get_executable_account>) return borrowed or executable accounts and apply optional condition checks. Other functions determine whether an account is writable, whether a transaction includes the BPF upgradeable loader, and whether an account is a demotion case. The file ends with account pre-condition functions like [`fd_txn_account_check_exists`](<#fd_txn_account_check_exists>), [`fd_txn_account_check_is_writable`](<#fd_txn_account_check_is_writable>), [`fd_txn_account_check_fee_payer_writable`](<#fd_txn_account_check_fee_payer_writable>), and [`fd_txn_account_check_borrow_mut`](<#fd_txn_account_check_borrow_mut>), which are used to filter accounts before execution.
